features.feature: Sandcrawler-like casemate: sloped walls narrowing to the deck, sloped glacis and stern
two long track units under thick hinged armour skirts
thick riveted appliqué plates on the walls and glacis
2B8-class 240 mm mortar raised steeply on the citadel (the main weapon, part mortar)
four deck turrets: twin 100 mm forward, Bofors 40 mm aft (parts turret_fl/fr/rl/rr)
155 mm bow casemate gun in a ball mantlet (part casemate)
twin Kornet launcher on the citadel (part kornet)
two ZU-23-2 on raised pedestals over the flanks (the roof-gun rule; parts zu23_l/r)
repair crane and welding gear on the rear deck (it patches itself up once)
the general's stripe along the deck edge

class_parts: running gear or lift by frame
